Tooltip_SilencerMoon_CopperSteelIngot: A homemade alloy of salvaged steel and copper. Good for suppressors that do not last long.
Tooltip_SilencerMoon_BallisticAlloyIngot: A reinforced metal made from firearm parts and remelted metals. Good for suppressors that last.
Tooltip_SilencerMoon_ScavengedOilFilter: An oil filter taken out of a vehicle. Makes an improvised suppressor.
Tooltip_SilencerMoon_Suppressor: Attach it to a compatible firearm with 'Upgrade' and take it off with 'Remove Upgrade'; both need a screwdriver. It muffles the shot but costs range and damage, and wears out as you fire.
Tooltip_SilencerMoon_Smelt: The pump shotgun may be broken, but it must be empty (nothing chambered, no spent shells) and have no parts attached.
Tooltip_SilencerMoon_MakeSuppressor: Learned from the magazine on homemade suppressors.
